summary: Trinity Biotech plc, an Irish foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting a commercial supply contract between its Trinovium subsidiary and Red Team Investments, a Texas owner of the X-MDC modular data center technology. The agreement establishes a framework to develop and deploy direct-to-chip liquid cooling solutions, with RTI committing to become a paid commercial pilot customer for Trinovium cooling fluids and analytical systems. No financial terms, pricing, volumes or duration were disclosed. Interim CFO Paul Murphy signed the September 9, 2026 filing. This is an ordinary product/supply contract, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies, with execution risk resting on pilot conversion.
